One day, at the ENCB, Prankedy showed up pulling his usual pranks and, because of one of them, accidentally ended up in the middle of an experiment that triggered the creation of an unknown, infectious compound, able to seep through latex. The mistake goes unnoticed… and time goes by.
The story prologue will go here (Prankedy\'s prank gone wrong at the ENCB…). For now, get ready to begin your adventure!

Draws far NPCs as emojis 🧍🚗🧟 and keeps the full sprite only for very close ones. Cuts render cost (ideal in multiplayer with many NPCs).
Replaces ALL NPC assets with emojis 🧍🚗🧟👮 regardless of distance. No sprites or bitmaps are generated: the lightest possible mode, for very weak devices.

Want a quick tour of the controls? You can revisit it anytime in Settings → Controls.
Walk with the D-pad or joystick. Style, size and side can be changed in Settings → Controls.
Hold A while moving to run.
X enters buildings (ESCOM, metro, metrobus…), picks up collectibles and uses mission items.
B throws punches. Careful: attacking civilians raises your wanted level and the police will come for you.
Y gets you in or out of the nearest car. Behind the wheel, the same movement control accelerates, brakes and steers.
Open the options menu (top right) → Map → Teleport points for fast travel.
X picks up keys and items, uses mission objects (like the stink can) and confirms actions.
B attacks: melee punch or shot, depending on the selected mode. NPCs also react to your hits.
Hold Y to open the combined menu: switch between punch and shoot, and check your inventory.
Review what each button does in each world. The settings above (style, size, side) change how they are laid out on screen.
